subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Recognises common consonant digraphs (sh, ch, th) at the beginning of a word

show.line: Two more! c and h say ch. ch, ch, chip. t and h say th. th, th, thumb.

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with ch, as in chip?
Which one starts with th, as in thumb?
Say the sound with me. ch, as in chip!
Listen. ch, i, n. What word is it?
Tap the letters that say th.
rounds.praise: t and h together say th.

rounds.prompt: Does it start with sh, ch or th? Sort the pictures.

hints: ch is like a sneeze. th puts your tongue between your teeth.
Two letters, one sound. Listen to the start.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with th.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Chip starts with ch. Thumb starts with th.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. th, th, thumb. Thumb starts with th!

parent_line: Can hear and read ch and th at the start of words.
